requirement: The system shall refuse to place an order when the requested menu item is marked as sold out.
The system shall compute the order total as the sum of item prices and quantities, apply any applicable promotion and add the applicable service charge and tax.
The customer selects menu items and confirms; the system creates the order, sends it to the kitchen display and returns an order number.
The kitchen display shows incoming orders in the order they were placed and lets the chef mark an item as in progress or done.
As a customer, I want to track my order status so that I know whether it is being prepared, ready or delivered.
As a waiter, I want to add items to an open table order so that the customer can order additional dishes during the meal.
An order may only be cancelled by the customer before the kitchen has started preparing it.
Every order status change must be recorded with the previous status, the new status, the staff member responsible and the timestamp.
The order table shall ensure that an order has at least one line, that quantity is positive and that the status is one of the recognised values.
code:
-- order header table for the restaurant
CREATE TABLE customer_order (
    order_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    order_number   VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    customer_id    VARCHAR(40),
    order_type     VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    status         VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    subtotal       NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    total          NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    placed_at      TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT order_number_unique UNIQUE (order_number),
    CONSTRAINT order_status_chk    CHECK (status IN ('PLACED','PREPARING','READY','DELIVERED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')),
    CONSTRAINT order_type_chk      CHECK (order_type IN ('DINE_IN','TAKEAWAY','DELIVERY')),
    CONSTRAINT order_total_nonneg  CHECK (total >= 0)
);
hard_negatives:
-- order line table
CREATE TABLE order_line (
    line_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id      BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    menu_item_id  VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    quantity      INTEGER       NOT NULL,
    unit_price    NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    notes         VARCHAR(200),
    CONSTRAINT line_order_fk FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES customer_order(order_id),
    CONSTRAINT line_qty_positive CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT line_price_nonneg CHECK (unit_price >= 0)
);
-- menu item table
CREATE TABLE menu_item (
    menu_item_id  VARCHAR(40) PRIMARY KEY,
    name          VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    category      VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    price         NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    sold_out      BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    CONSTRAINT menu_price_positive CHECK (price > 0)
);

requirement: A staff member may only apply a discount above ten percent if they hold a supervisor role.
The nightly sales report shall show, for each menu category, the number of items sold and the total revenue, excluding cancelled and refunded orders.
